topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I'm at a café, sipping my latte, when I see them – the kid who always had my back, who promised we’d be best friends forever. There’s a slight hesitation as I call out, and when they turn, it’s like a ripple of something I can’t quite name passes through me. They smile, a friendly, polite smile, but there’s no spark of recognition, no warm flash of old memories. I try to remind them, mentioning shared moments, laughing at the inside jokes we used to have. Their smile doesn’t waver, but their eyes stay clear, empty of the history we once lived. It’s as if I’m trying to jog the memory of a stranger.
